![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

In Windows PowerShell 5.1 (the default PowerShell version on Windows 11 and Windows Server), the `New-Service` cmdlet does not support the `-Description` parameter. Attempting to run this script on standard Windows hosts will result in a `ParameterBindingException` and fail the installation. To resolve this, remove the `-Description` parameter from the `New-Service` calls and instead set the service descriptions using `sc.exe description` via the existing `Invoke-Native` helper.

```
    New-Service -Name $helperName -BinaryPathName "`"$binary`" helper" -DisplayName 'CIE PR Runner Restricted Lifecycle Helper' -StartupType Automatic | Out-Null
    New-Service -Name $controllerName -BinaryPathName "`"$binary`" controller" -DisplayName 'CIE PR Runner Controller' -StartupType Automatic -Credential $credential -DependsOn $helperName | Out-Null
    Invoke-Native -FilePath "$env:SystemRoot\System32\sc.exe" -Arguments @('description', $helperName, 'Fixed-schema Hyper-V lifecycle helper for disposable CIE PR runners.')
    Invoke-Native -FilePath "$env:SystemRoot\System32\sc.exe" -Arguments @('description', $controllerName, 'Unprivileged controller for disposable CIE PR runner lifecycle admission.')
```
